Apple Addresses Initial Screen Defects in New iPhone Duo Foldable

28 Oct 2026, 07:31 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

Addressing Display Failures

Apple has confirmed that a small number of its newly launched iPhone Duo handsets are experiencing inner display issues, including vertical lines and center crease cracks. The foldable device, which represents Apple’s first entry into the segment, launched globally last week with prices starting at £1,999.

Impact and Resolution

While Apple has not disclosed the total number of affected units, the company is urging customers experiencing display defects to contact them for a replacement. Reports have also emerged regarding mechanical sounds when opening the device. Industry analysts suggest the company’s response to these early manufacturing hurdles will be critical to maintaining buyer confidence in the premium foldable market. The extent of the issue remains uncertain, as some reported images may be unverified. Owners can consult official support channels for warranty assistance: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c893zwlev2xpo
